topic: Are the proposed power allocation strategies compatible with existing satellite frequency planning and interference management frameworks?
response: The proposed power allocation strategies appear to be compatible with existing satellite frequency planning and interference management frameworks, as they utilize market-based mechanisms and dynamic game models to manage inter-cell interference. However, explicit compatibility metrics or standards are not provided in the context.
